email.subject1: a signal play for Power Factors
email.body1:
Steve, saw Power Factors took the Mubadala investment and just launched Unity REMI built on 310 GW of assets.

Scaling that fast in the Americas usually means more in-market accounts in play than your team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where good deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Power Factors off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Steve, quick follow-up for Power Factors Americas.

With new investment and REMI to sell, the regional number tends to climb faster than headcount can, and most sales orgs cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap surfaces late, when saving the quarter is already a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your Americas team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Steve, last bit of proof for Power Factors.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Power Factors' reply rate likely compares to other high-growth energy software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Steve, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling Americas pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after new investment and a launch, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an energy-software motion? I will tailor it to Power Factors either way.
